A day and a night back through the Grauklamm, half of
Rin's army at your heels. The Wallfeste is burning when
you reach it: fire on the north wall, bells everywhere.
Princess. Vessel. You're late, and I have never been so
Everywhere. They came out of the Aschenfeld at dusk,
the whole Host: brass soldiers, oni, hounds, and him.
Gōen. On a throne of siege engines, like a merchant
They're in the Torturm, the gate tower over the north
gate. If they reach the winch, the gate opens, and then
it's the courtyard, and then it's over.
My people take the walls. Kanta: the tower?
From the bottom up, my Lord, and drop the portcullis
before anything else. A gate is a promise; keep it shut.

West along the Wallweg in the dark, under a sky that
flickers with the Host's fires. Twice you hide in the
snow while something big goes past.
The portcullis is down. That's the first good thing
But it doesn't matter how many we kill. Every soldier
who falls on this wall gets up an hour later wearing
brass and walks back at us.
A soul cauldron. Gōen boils the dead back into their
bodies and sends them in again. I've seen it. We burned
one on the Shimo plain, three hundred years before you.
Then it's in their camp. On the Aschenfeld, beyond the
old breach at Frontposten 3. Mori's still holding, just.
The new stone has a sally port.
I can't go with you. If I leave the walls, they break.
Along the Wallweg, in the dark. Mori will let you out
onto the ash. Break that pot.
